reason: The upstream integration replaces issue responsibility and delivery with execution-owner escalation, moves records and recyclable workspaces to daemon-owned storage, and adds turn/item traces and Chat follow-up queues. Fork shared-operator, dual-owner Session and model-catalog migrations are retained. No earlier schema fingerprint is attested for code-only rollback. Existing deployments require the ADR 0018 and ADR 0019 controlled cutover steps; publishing this bundle does not authorize a production migration. Same-schema updates still require backup verification and target/previous migration rehearsal.
